review.tagline: Prompt rewriting and testing tool for web, desktop, Chrome and MCP
review.summary: Prompt Optimizer rewrites system and user prompts with an LLM you configure, then lets you test, compare and save the results as versioned favorites. It runs as a browser app, desktop app, Chrome extension or Docker container, and exposes an MCP server at /mcp with optimize-user-prompt, optimize-system-prompt and iterate-prompt tools. Model calls go straight from the client to the provider, including text-to-image and image-to-image modes.
review.audience: Users who write and iterate on LLM prompts and want a dedicated tool
strengths: Ships as web app, desktop app, Chrome extension and Docker image
Built-in MCP server at /mcp for Claude Desktop and other MCP clients
Analysis and compare evaluation, variables, multi-turn and function-calling tests
Client-side processing; requests go directly to the configured provider
weaknesses: Web version may hit browser CORS limits with local endpoints such as Ollama
VITE_* API keys are exposed in browser assets on public deployments
Chrome Web Store version can lag behind the latest release
Workspace/project management is still unchecked on the roadmap
needs: Needs LLM provider API key or compatible endpoint
Models: OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Zhipu AI
